ops.title: aws CLI launch sources on the launcher Mac and what replaced them
ops.body:
Sampled 2026-11-12 18:08-18:18 PST with `ps -axo pid,ppid,lstart,command` every 0.2 s, counting distinct aws pids and their parents: 404 aws launches (40.4 a minute). 238 came from an agent's own ssm-run.zsh get-command-invocation poll, which is out of scope. The 166 left (16.6 a minute) break down as:
- monorepo tools/artifact.sh presign, run as cc-remote url_command, 3 aws each: 95
- cc-remote orca.keys trunk and aws: 24
- cc-remote orca.keys.env `sh -c` (ssm get-parameter plus configure get): 23
- Codex sentry MCP launch in ~/.codex/config.toml: 14
- kubectl eks get-token exec plugin: 6
- monorepo tools/ci bk api: 2
- ccx github-app private_key_command: 2

cc-remote v0.27.42 (#156, #157) answers the key forms in-process with aws-sdk-go-v2. It keeps profile sessions, never parameter values, in 0600 files under ~/.local/state/cc-remote/aws, reuses the env line for 10 min, and reuses a signed payload URL for 3 min while at least 10 min of validity remain. It adds `cc-remote key -- <cmd>`. ~/.codex/config.toml and ~/.config/ccx/github-app.toml now call /opt/homebrew/bin/cc-remote key. The pool fill and prepare paths pick this up only once the monorepo pin moves to 0.27.42.
